description: This file defines functions and types for parsing, comparing, and handling version strings specific to the OpenClaw project, including version normalization, comparison, and stability checks.

classes.name: OpenClawVersion
classes.description: Type representing the structure of an OpenClaw version, including major, minor, patch, revision, and prerelease components.

methods.name: parseOpenClawVersion
methods.description: Parses a version string into an OpenClawVersion object, normalizing and extracting version components.

methods.name: normalizeOpenClawVersionBase
methods.description: Returns the base version string (major.minor.patch) from a version string.

methods.name: isSameOpenClawStableFamily
methods.description: Checks if two version strings belong to the same stable family (same major, minor, patch, no prerelease).

methods.name: compareOpenClawVersions
methods.description: Compares two version strings, returning -1, 0, or 1 based on their order, or null if invalid.

methods.name: shouldWarnOnTouchedVersion
methods.description: Determines if a warning should be issued when a version is touched/modified, based on version comparison and stability.
